# v0.1.29 preview

When retrying a submission blocked by a base-commit mismatch, the poller
checks the open pull requests and branch tips listed during the current
pass. If the tested commit is no longer current because its pull request
closed or its branch moved or was deleted, the poller marks the old status
as superseded. If the poller has not listed open pull requests in this
pass, it defers that decision for pull requests.
